One of them recently ordered an M4. It needs a suppressor, a 60-round magazine, ergonomics at or above 37, combined recoil below 300, a weight of no more than 3.8 kg, and a sighting range above 800.}} ==Requirements== * This quest is only obtainable by [[USEC]] PMCs. ==Objectives== * Modify an [[M4A1]] to comply with the given specifications ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * [[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.75''' * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|Let's have a closer look. Right... the weapon of democracy, indeed. Everything checks out.}} ==Guide== [[M4A1]] specifications: *60 Durability *37 or greater ergonomics *300 or less recoil *800 or greater sighting range *3.8 kg or less in weight *A magazine with a capacity of at least 60 *A silencer ==Builds== '''This is one example of many possible configurations.''' ====Notes:==== * This build is based on a standard [[M4A1]] from [[Peacekeeper]] LL3. * The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
